verdict.rationale: The evidence documents CPU optimizations only for ARM (NEON on Apple silicon) and x86 (AVX/AVX2/AVX512/AMX), which are exactly the architectures the story excludes. Nothing in the pack mentions PowerPC, RISC-V, s390x or any other CPU architecture. The dependency-free C/C++ implementation hints at portability but is not a documented capability for non-x86/ARM targets.
